entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hello, Charlie. I'm calling about an order I received about 20 days ago. I need to return a helmet.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, could you please provide your order number?
Thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Frame Helmet here. Before we proceed, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. The color just isn't what I expected from the pictures online. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just pull up our return policy information for standard items like this one.

Okay, I've got it here. Our policy states that you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. Since you received it 20 days ago, you are well within that window. I can approve this return for you right now.
Oh, great. That's fantastic. I appreciate that.
Of course. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off with the carrier.

That's very efficient, thank you. Now, since I am going to be ordering a replacement, and I've had a bit of an inconvenience here with the color and having to send it back, would it be possible to get a small 15% discount code for my next purchase? It would ensure I buy the new one from you.

I'm glad I could help with the return process. We definitely want you to be happy with your gear, especially when it comes to an important piece of safety equipment like a helmet. However, I'm afraid I'm not authorized to provide discount codes for preference-based returns. You will receive a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item.
I understand. Figured it couldn't hurt to ask. Thank you for processing the return so quickly.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Charlie.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
